title: Apple iPhone 17 Pro 256GB Silver $1,600 Delivered @ Skytree Phones
body:
Deal: Apple iPhone 17 Pro 256GB Silver $1,600 Delivered @ Skytree Phones

[Br0cxen] Sorry, i used another post as a template as this is my first post. It’s for the 17 pro. Have updated the title.
[daven1985] I wouldn't buy right now. New phones being announced tomorrow at 3am… prices will drop everywhere on the 17 Pro Max.
[Br0cxen] 30 day return so can hedge my bets. But doubt it will be cheaper. Plus iPhone 18 pro/pro max will likely see a price increase meaning more people will be after the 17.
[doxxie] the new phones are already going to be more expensive, so i wouldnt expect them to drop as much as in previous years
[BennyHe2018] Really good price to price beat at Officeworks.
[Br0cxen] They won’t even over the phone, and it seems to be luck of the draw if a store will. My local store had no issues. They knew exactly who skytree was, and hardly even looked at the advertisement.
[Haunt] I'm jealous, my local Officeworks goes in real deep and looks for SKUs, ABN, addresses and other stuff.. won't even agree for a price match on a $24 phone case :(
[stewface] Def wait till tomorrow morning people! It’s new iPhone day!
[Br0cxen] When people see the price of the new 18 pro release, there will be a scurry to buy the 17 pro/max
[stewface] Thanks AI memfest.
I’m still thinking people will buy the latest greatest and old models will get cheaper… who doesn’t want a folding iPhone?
[Arthas91] i highly doubt that the better screen, processor will make a world of a difference vs the old flagship at a big discount, especially the massive price hike coming in the new iphone
[stewface] Especially without the seductive voice of Jonny Ives trying to sell it to you.
[He-Mania] Don't they usually somehow get retailers to stop selling last years model on new release?
[jlogic] They can't get stock of the older models anymore. What they have will be what they can sell.
[FujinShu] They don’t prevent retailers from selling the older phones, they just discontinue the pro models from sale
[The Hog] 6 hours to new chip and slight camera update day!
[FujinShu] Variable aperture seems like a pretty big game changer for photography, but I doubt it will be worth the (AI-induced) price increase.
[Cludos] No deal.
Got 2 x brand new 17 pro max for $2500 in March lol
[JoeBogan] Fakebook marketplace is a cesspool, gotta be careful but bargains can be had
[stirlo] If this price is available tomorrow morning after the iPhone 18 announcement (and probable price increase) then it might be a pretty decent deal
[viper8548] 5 hours until apple invents the folding phone!!!!
[socceroo] Tried 2 local stores today to match Skytree price on Pro Max with no success.
[azzaisawesome] Officeworks don’t price match Skytree as they are not an authorised reseller!! If you buy an iPhone from Skytree and take it to Apple, Apple won’t touch it as they know of Skytree that should be blacklisted!!
[Br0cxen] Many people, myself included, have got OW to price match Skytree. Just depends on the store. You won’t get them to do it over the phone though.
[nguyentran] even if skytree is grey imported, apple is still be bounded with their limited one year warranty, if it's X/A stock, business as usual
[cpapi] JB has blanket banned them, plenty of success with OW.
Apple couldn’t give AF where you got it from as long as it’s not blacklisted, iCloud locked, counterfeit or had third party repairs.
They don’t care where you get it from, they’ve sold it to somebody to have it out in the wild that’s good enough for them, if it was obtained illegally they’ll blacklist the IMEI as they’ve done before when shipments go missing.
[mmd] Can anyone upload an Officeworks receipt for price protection?
